definitions: A domesticated hoofed mammal with a stout body, short legs, and a snouted head, kept for its meat.
The meat of a pig, used as food.
A person, especially a child, who is greedy or untidy.
An oblong mass of metal, such as iron or lead, run from a smelting furnace.
examples: We had roast pig for dinner.
Don't be such a pig, share your sweets!
They cast the molten iron into pigs.
